message:
Review of the first almanac (not saved yet). The folder has 4 files, all processed without failures.

CONFLICT (needs a board decision)
- Court hours: club rules say "Courts are open from 7:00 a.m. to 9:00 p.m. every day." (club-rules-2022.pdf). The notice of 2024-03-20 says "Courts are now open from 7:00 a.m. to 10:00 p.m." (notice-2024-03-20.txt). The only later motion to extend to 10 p.m. failed 2-2 (committee-minutes-2024-03-05.docx). I have recorded this as a conflict and have not picked a winner.

CURRENT RULES
- Guest fees: $15 per visit, from 2024-04-01. Set by a 3-1 committee vote on 2024-03-05 ("the guest fee is raised to $15 per visit, effective April 1, 2024. Motion carried 3-1."). Replaces $10 from the 2022 club rules. The notice of 2024-03-20 stating $12 was corrected by the 2024-06-11 minutes ("The adopted guest fee is $15 per visit.").
- Court booking: weekdays no more than two hours per day (club rules, 2022-03-01). Saturdays and Sundays no more than 90 minutes per day (4-0 vote, 2024-03-05, "Weekday booking is unchanged.").
- Governance: club rules may be amended by a majority vote of the committee (club-rules-2022.pdf).
- Open items: none.

QUESTIONS FOR YOU
1. club-rules-2022.pdf is typed as bylaws, but its amendment clause lets the committee change it by majority vote. I treated the 3-1 fee vote as valid under that clause. Please confirm this reading.
2. The weekend court limit has no effective date in its quoted sentence. I used the decision date 2024-03-05.
